subject: Request to expand orderform throughput + reprice for Q1 ramp
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@brightwave.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: add throughput & pricing for Q1 ramp

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had an internal planning sync and want to accelerate our ramp in Q1. Specifically: we need to add an additional 250K generation tokens/month (on top of the committed tier) and would like to understand the commercial impact if we bring that forward to Jan 1.

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood add the extra throughput as an amendment to our existing Order Form (deal BW-8421)?
- If so, what is the delta to monthly fees and any impact to implementation schedule?
- We prefer an amendment rather than a brand new order; please share a marked-up redline and an estimate.

I attached a short request doc that summarizes expected consumption patterns and required SLOs (BrightWave_ChangeRequest_Dec2026.pdf). We also need an answer by EOD Dec 3 to align procurement and our finance team.

Thanks — looking to move quickly on this.

Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of Product Operations
BrightWave Health

---
Attachment: BrightWave_ChangeRequest_Dec2026.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: add throughput & pricing for Q1 ramp

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the heads-up and the attachment. We can absolutely support an amendment to the current Order Form to capture the additional 250K tokens/month. I’ve looped Legal (Naomi) and Contracts/Implementation (Irene) to scope the redline and timing.

Immediate plan:
1) Naomi will prepare a redline to the Order Form (we’ll start from the signed OrderForm_BW-8421_Signed.pdf).
2) I’ll work with Pricing to produce a one-page delta (monthly fee delta + any prorated implementation charge for bringing capacity forward).
3) Irene will confirm whether there’s any impact to the onboarding window (possible additional ramp hours).

If this works, we’ll target sending a marked-up Word and a clean amendment PDF by EOD Dec 2 so you can circulate to Procurement.

Quick clarification request: should the added tokens be treated as a temporary Q1-only top-up (Jan–Mar) or a permanent commit increase starting Jan 1? That changes the price bands.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Naomi posts the redline.

Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments referenced: OrderForm_BW-8421_Signed.pdf (signed order form)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightwave.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: add throughput & pricing for Q1 ramp — redline attached

Elena —

Thanks — attached is a first-pass redline to the Order Form and a short amendment stub (redline-orderform-v2.docx). Summary of changes:

- Scope: Insert Exhibit X (Temporary Top-Up) that adds 250,000 tokens/month for Jan 1–Mar 31, 2027, with explicit auto-expiry unless both parties execute a conversion amendment.
- Pricing: Two options included in the amendment (both listed in the redline):
  a) Temporary top-up: blended per-token surcharge at the overage rate of $0.0035/token for the top-up months, prorated for Jan start date.
  b) Permanent commit increase: If BrightWave converts to a permanent uplift, we propose a revised committed rate of $0.0022/token for the entire commitment (requires updated minimums and a 12‑month commitment term).
- Implementation: Minor schedule impact — we propose an extra 16 onboarding hours (billed at the standard implementation rate) to validate prefix caching and burst capacity.
- Legal: Minimal MSA adjustments limited to Exhibit references and a short amendment clause; no changes to indemnities or data handling.

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether you prefer temporary top-up (a) or permanent commit (b). If temporary, we’ll prepare a clean amendment and invoice schedule; if permanent, we’ll prepare updated Order Form pages and send for signature.
- If you need procurement language around prorating and billing timing, I can add a redlined billing schedule paragraph.

Irene — can you confirm the estimated implementation hours and whether we can absorb any of that effort into our onboarding SLA for Q1?

Elena — attaching the redline here as requested.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
